name: Scaring Shaky
summary: At Booty Bay's docks, “Shaky” Phillipe still owes “Sea Wolf” MacKinley from last week's game. MacKinley sends you outside town for Elder Mistvale Gorilla giblets to frighten Phillipe into paying.

sections.title: Collecting a Debt
sections.body: “Sea Wolf” MacKinley wants his gambling debts paid, and many people owe him. “Shaky” Phillipe is first. He waits by the docks in Booty Bay and owes a large sum from last week's game. MacKinley sends you outside town to hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas and bring back plenty of giblets. Keep their animal origin quiet, so Phillipe imagines the worst.

sections.title: Phillipe's Reaction
sections.body: “Shaky” Phillipe recoils at the giblets and wants nothing to do with where they came from. Then he asks whether Sea Wolf sent you.

faq.answer: “Sea Wolf” MacKinley is owed gambling debts by many people. He wants help collecting them, beginning with “Shaky” Phillipe.

faq.q: Why does MacKinley want to scare "Shaky" Phillipe?
faq.answer: Phillipe still owes MacKinley a large sum from last week's game. MacKinley hopes a fright will make him pay.

aliases: what do i kill for giblets
faq.answer: MacKinley says the giblets come from Elder Mistvale Gorillas outside town.
“Shaky” Phillipe can be found by the docks in Booty Bay.

faq.q: What should you tell Phillipe about the giblets?
aliases: do i tell shaky where giblets came from
faq.answer: Say nothing about where the giblets came from. MacKinley wants Phillipe to imagine the worst.
